items.sentence: After dinner I sweep crumbs from the wooden floor.
I glance at the wall clock before setting the table.
These brown shoes match the warm winter coat very well.
Movers carried light furniture into the empty living room today.
The rice cooker manual lists each step in the correct order.
The value of this old wooden chair rose after careful repair.
Steam rises from the pot of barley tea on the stove.
Milk, eggs, and bread fill our grocery bag this evening.
A striped towel hangs neatly beside the bathroom mirror.
My mind still remembers the smell of grandmother's warm kitchen.
